sources.title: Nemotron Parse v2.0 | NVIDIA NGC
sources.snippet: This container houses the NVIDIA Nemotron Parse v2.0 model. NVIDIA Nemotron Parse 2.0 transforms document images into structured, machine-readable representations with text, layout classes, bounding boxes, and reading-order information.
